_comment: Example settings.json with all three claude-personas hooks installed. Merge this into your own ~/.claude/settings.json (or project-level .claude/settings.json). See ../README.md for context.

hooks._comment: Block git push --force / -f (including combined short flags like -fv, -fu, -vf) AND the +ref:ref refspec force form. See no-force-push.md.
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push[^&|;]*[[:space:]]+(--force([[:space:]]|=|$)|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*([[:space:]]|=|$)|\+[^[:space:]:]+:[^[:space:]]+)' && { echo 'Blocked: force-push is destructive. Use --force-with-lease if you genuinely need to rewrite, or sync via fetch + rebase.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

hooks._comment: Block cd out of the worktree. See no-cd-out-of-repo.md.
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+[^-]' && { echo 'Blocked: cd persists across Bash calls and risks operating in the wrong repo. Use `git -C <abs-path>` for cross-repo git ops, or absolute paths with Read/Write/Edit tools. For one-off subshells where cd is genuinely needed: `(cd /path && cmd)`.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

hooks._comment: Block git commit/push/merge chained in one shell call. See no-chained-commit-push.md.
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(commit|push)[^&|;]*[&|;]+[[:space:]]*(git[[:space:]]+(push|merge)|gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+merge)' && { echo 'Blocked: do not chain git commit/push/merge in one call. Split into separate Bash invocations so you (and the user) can see the state between each step.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
